description: Implement the Evolution Engine module (observer, analyzer, proposer, sandbox, evaluator, promoter, skill evolution, agent evolution) under src/nexus/evolution/.
steps: Create src/nexus/evolution/__init__.py exporting main classes: EvolutionObserver, FailureAnalyzer, ImprovementProposer, EvolutionSandbox, ProposalEvaluator, ChangePromoter, SkillEvolution, AgentEvolution.

Create src/nexus/evolution/observer.py implementing EvolutionObserver class: track_execution(company_id, agent_id, task_id, outcome, duration, cost, metadata) records execution data, detect_patterns(company_id, window_days=7) analyzes recent executions to find recurring failures/slow tasks/cost spikes returning list of Pattern dataclass (pattern_type, description, severity, occurrences, examples), detect_anomalies(company_id, metric, threshold_std=2.0) flags values outside normal range, classify_pattern(pattern) returns 'systemic' or 'one_off' based on occurrence count and time spread.

Create src/nexus/evolution/analyzer.py implementing FailureAnalyzer class: root_cause_analysis(company_id, failed_executions: list[dict]) groups failures by common factors (agent, task_type, time, tool) returning RootCause dataclass, extract_success_factors(company_id, successful_executions: list[dict]) identifies what successful tasks have in common, compare_outcomes(successes, failures) returns comparative analysis dict highlighting differences, identify_bottlenecks(company_id, execution_history) finds stages/agents/tools that slow things down, cost_effectiveness_analysis(company_id, executions) calculates cost per quality unit for different approaches.

Create src/nexus/evolution/proposer.py implementing ImprovementProposer class: propose_skill_improvement(company_id, skill_id, failure_analysis) generates EvolutionProposal for better prompts/tools, propose_workflow_change(company_id, bottleneck_analysis) proposes reordering/parallelism, propose_agent_config(company_id, agent_id, performance_data) proposes model/budget changes, propose_org_change(company_id, performance_data, org_structure) proposes new agent or restructure. Each method returns EvolutionProposal with expected_impact, confidence (0-1), risk_level, estimated_cost_cents. All proposals are auditable with proposer identity and timestamp.

Create src/nexus/evolution/sandbox.py implementing EvolutionSandbox class: create_sandbox(proposal_id, config: dict) returns sandbox_id with isolated environment config, run_benchmark(sandbox_id, test_cases: list[dict]) executes proposal against historical data returning results list, compare_with_baseline(sandbox_results, baseline_results) computes improvement metrics, enforce_resource_limits(sandbox_id, max_cost_cents, max_duration_seconds) applies limits, cleanup(sandbox_id) marks sandbox as cleaned. Sandbox is logical (in-memory dict tracking state) not actual process isolation.

Create src/nexus/evolution/evaluator.py implementing ProposalEvaluator class: evaluate(proposal_id, sandbox_results, baseline_results) creates EvolutionEvaluation record with scores across dimensions (quality, speed, cost, safety), check_significance(improvement_percent, sample_size, confidence_level=0.95) returns bool using simple threshold heuristic, check_promotion_criteria(evaluation, min_improvement_percent=5.0) returns pass/fail, reject_with_explanation(proposal_id, reasons: list[str]) updates proposal status to rejected with notes.

Create src/nexus/evolution/promoter.py implementing ChangePromoter class: promote(proposal_id, evaluation_id) - REQUIRES approval_id to be set on proposal (governance gate, raises error if no approval), apply_change(proposal) applies the proposed change to production config, configure_canary(proposal_id, percentage=10) sets up gradual rollout tracking, monitor_canary(proposal_id, metrics) checks if canary is degrading, rollback(proposal_id, reason) reverts change and updates status to rolled_back, get_change_history(company_id) returns all promotions with before/after metrics. CRITICAL: promote() must verify proposal.approval_id is not None - evolution never auto-promotes.

Create src/nexus/evolution/skill_evolution.py implementing SkillEvolution class: create_version(company_id, skill_id, prompt_template) creates new SkillVersion record, track_performance(version_id, task_results: list[dict]) updates performance_score, compare_versions(skill_id, version_a_id, version_b_id) returns comparison dict, promote_version(version_id) - REQUIRES approval gate - activates new version and deactivates old, rollback_version(skill_id) reactivates previous version, get_version_history(skill_id) returns all versions with scores.

Create src/nexus/evolution/agent_evolution.py implementing AgentEvolution class: create_candidate(company_id, agent_id, proposed_config: dict) creates AgentVersion snapshot, optimize_model_selection(agent_id, task_type_performance: dict) recommends best model per task type, optimize_tools(agent_id, tool_usage_stats: dict) recommends tool set changes, optimize_budget(agent_id, cost_history, quality_history) recommends budget adjustment, promote_candidate(version_id) - REQUIRES approval gate - applies new config to agent, get_evolution_history(agent_id) returns version history.
acceptance_criteria: EvolutionObserver can track executions and detect patterns/anomalies
FailureAnalyzer provides root cause analysis and success factor extraction
EvolutionSandbox provides isolated testing environment with resource limits
ProposalEvaluator scores proposals and checks promotion criteria
ChangePromoter REFUSES to promote without approval_id (governance gate enforced)
SkillEvolution and AgentEvolution both require approval for promotion
All proposals are auditable (who, when, why, outcome)
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -c "from nexus.evolution import EvolutionObserver, FailureAnalyzer, ImprovementProposer, EvolutionSandbox, ProposalEvaluator, ChangePromoter, SkillEvolution, AgentEvolution; print('Evolution module imports OK')"
findings: All 9 evolution module files created and verified via ast.parse and runtime imports. Governance gates tested: all 3 promote methods raise ValueError when approval_id is None. pytest unavailable (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), but all logic verified via asyncio runtime tests. ProposalEvaluator significance check uses heuristic threshold 2/sqrt(n)*100, requiring 64+ samples for 25% improvement to pass.
